# Party Favor — *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic* (G4)

Party Favor is the cheerful, balloon-sculpting blue unicorn from Starlight Glimmer’s “equal” village, later called Our Town. He is one of the four villagers—alongside Double Diamond, Sugar Belle, and Night Glider—whose recovered individuality helps rescue the Mane Six. Recognize his pale-aqua coat, bouncy dark-blue curls, blue eyes, and pink balloon-animal-and-streamers cutie mark. Under Starlight’s rule, that mark was replaced with an equal sign.

His name is *official within the TV story*, not a fan nickname: Double Diamond introduces him as “Party Favor” in [“The Cutie Map – Part 1” (S5E1)](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/The_Cutie_Map_-_Part_1). The licensed collectible card game also calls him *Party Favor, Balloon Master*—a card title, not a secret identity ([High Magic card #29](https://data.mlpmerch.com/ccg/details/hm29/)). He has spoken dialogue, voiced in English by Sam Vincent ([S5E1 cast credit](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt3721734/characters/nm0451918/)).

Beyond the S5 premiere, he appears in “The Cutie Re-Mark – Part 2” (S5E26), “To Where and Back Again” (S6E25–26), and the 2017 film, where he cries out for his popped balloon animal Brian ([film dialogue](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt4131800/quotes/?item=qt3754340)). Later brief appearances include *Rainbow Roadtrip*. These are appearances in the G4 television/film continuity, not evidence of a separate alter ego.

## Important moments

1. **A forbidden wish for a cutie mark — “The Cutie Map – Part 1” (S5E1).** Party Favor privately admits he wants his individual talent back, exposing the unhappiness behind Our Town’s compulsory sameness. [Official full two-part episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ivY8-UyegUw); verified scene timestamp unavailable.
2. **Taking the blame — “The Cutie Map – Part 2” (S5E2).** When Starlight discovers dissent, he shoulders responsibility rather than implicating his friends, showing loyalty even while frightened ([episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/The_Cutie_Map_-_Part_2)); timestamp unavailable.
3. **Exposing Starlight and building the bridge — “The Cutie Map – Part 2” (S5E2).** He helps reveal Starlight’s concealed real cutie mark, then uses his restored balloon talent to span a mountain gap in the pursuit that recovers the Mane Six’s marks. [Licensed streaming episode page](https://www.nowtv.com/watch/my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic/iYEQYZ6ymh22BCLb91Vd3m/seasons/5/episodes/the-cutie-map-part-2-episode-2/A5EK3JYiLcaCh6GgWNkQ5); timestamp unavailable.
4. **A chance for reconciliation — “To Where and Back Again – Part 2” (S6E26).** Party Favor greets the reformed Starlight when she finally returns to the Sunset Festival, helping bring their troubled village history to a gentler close. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Xau6Cf7VoXA); timestamp unavailable ([scene transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/To_Where_and_Back_Again_-_Part_2)).
